transactionName: HIPAA Health Care Claim: Professional X222A1-837
description: Enriched schema for the Health Care Claim Transaction Set (837). This schema includes structural definitions, element-level constraints, and codified complex validation rules derived from the implementation guide.

rules.description: The Originator Application Transaction Identifier (BHT03) is limited to 30 characters.
The Total Claim Charge Amount (CLM02) must balance to the sum of all service line charge amounts (SV102).
If the claim is related to an Auto (AA) or Other (OA) Accident, the Accident Date (DTP with qualifier 439) is required.
The Pay-To Plan Name Loop (2010AC) may only be used when BHT06 (Claim or Encounter Identifier) is '31' (Subrogation Demand).

1000A.NM1.name: Submitter Name
1000A.NM1.description: Identifies the entity submitting the transaction set.

1000B.NM1.name: Receiver Name
1000B.NM1.description: Identifies the entity intended to receive the transaction set.

2010AA.NM1.name: Billing Provider Name
2010AA.NM1.description: Identifies the provider to be paid for the services rendered.

2010BA.NM1.name: Subscriber Name
2010BA.NM1.description: Identifies the person who is the policyholder for the insurance.

2010CA.NM1.name: Patient Name
2010CA.NM1.description: Identifies the person who received the medical services, if different from the subscriber.

2300.CLM.description: Contextual override for CLM segment in 2300 Claim Information Loop, required once.

ISA.name: Interchange Control Header
ISA.description: To start and identify an interchange of zero or more functional groups and interchange-related control segments.

GS.name: Functional Group Header
GS.description: To indicate the beginning of a functional group and to provide control information.

CLM.name: Claim Information
CLM.description: Specifies essential data about the claim being processed.

elements.name: Patient Control Number
elements.description: Identifier used to track a claim from creation by the health care provider through payment.

elements.name: Total Claim Charge Amount
elements.description: Total amount of all submitted charges of service segments for this claim.

elements.name: Claim Filing Indicator Code
elements.description: Code indicating the type of claim.

elements.name: Non-Institutional Claim Type Code
elements.description: Code indicating the type of non-institutional claim.

elements.name: Health Care Service Location Information
elements.description: Identifies the place of service or the type of bill related to the location at which a health care service was rendered.

elements.name: Provider or Supplier Signature Indicator
elements.description: Indicates whether a provider's signature is on file for a claim.

elements.name: Assignment or Plan Participation Code
elements.description: Indicates whether the provider accepts assignment.

elements.name: Benefits Assignment Certification Indicator
elements.description: Indicates if the insured has authorized the plan to remit payment directly to the provider.

elements.name: Release of Information Code
elements.description: Indicates whether the provider has on file a signed statement by the patient authorizing the release of medical data to other organizations.

elements.name: Patient Signature Source Code
elements.description: Code indicating how the patient or subscriber authorization signatures were obtained and how they are being retained by the provider.

elements.name: Related Causes Information
elements.description: Optional information to identify related causes of an illness or accident.
